bracelet-tennis-en-diamants.title: Diamond tennis bracelet
bracelet-tennis-en-diamants.description: A classic, a timeless piece. A design that has been loved, is loved, and will go on being loved. Worn for an occasion or every day, it will always make its effect. So let yourself be tempted, and shine. Customisable - choose the size of your diamonds (min 2mm - max 4mm).

ami.title: AMI
ami.description: Trilogy engagement ring with a cathedral setting. This model is composed of a 2.5ct oval diamond and a pair of 0.30ctw trillions. Customisable model. Starting price for the trilogy with trillions - centre stone to be selected separately.

pendentif-personnalisable.title: Customisable pendant
pendentif-personnalisable.description: As a necklace or a bracelet, this pendant is worn as you wish. Choose the shape of the diamond, with or without a halo, and wear it on a chain or a cord. This pendant is customisable: choice of shape, size, characteristics and gold colour. Write to us and make it your own. Chains and cords sold separately. Starting price for a 0.30ct lab-grown diamond. Diamond carats in the photograph: 1ct and 2ct.

creole-en-diamants.title: Diamond hoop earring
creole-en-diamants.description: A magnificent diamond hoop, a single earring set with a micro pavé of diamonds and four suspended diamonds.

elya.title: ÉLYA
elya.description: Élya – Oneiro drop earrings. Infinitely graceful, our drop earrings catch the light in a spellbinding shimmer. A pavé of diamonds sparkles with intensity, revealing every facet of pure brilliance, while pear-cut diamonds sway gently, like drops of suspended light. Every detail embodies airy elegance and absolute refinement, the Oneiro signature. Designed to magnify every movement, they light up the face with a sophisticated glow, perfect for a precious occasion or for timeless luxury worn every day. A dream of light, sculpted into eternity.

lena.title: LÉNA
lena.description: Timeless brilliance – Léna earrings. A symbol of purity and refinement, our stud earrings capture the very essence of timeless elegance. Made with exquisite precision, they light up the face with a subtle glow, revealing beauty in its most pared-back form. Each pair is an invitation to sophisticated simplicity, an everyday piece that elevates effortlessly. Their minimalist design, heightened by precious materials, reflects the Oneiro vision: a dream of light and perfection. Worn alone for a discreet touch or paired with other creations, these earrings embody natural elegance and the timelessness of French luxury.

collier.title: LYRA
collier.description: This yellow gold pendant traces a perfect circle paved with diamonds, within which five mobile stones of varying sizes float freely. Their natural movement catches the light at every moment, like a shower of stars suspended at the neck. A piece that is both delicate and original, drawing the eye without ever overstating itself.

bague-6.title: PERSÉE
bague-6.description: A bold design in which every diamond stands out: marquise, round, pear and emerald cuts balance one another in a modern composition in yellow gold. A sculptural, brilliant piece, made for those who like to stand apart.

bague-5.title: DYA
bague-5.description: A bold and harmonious creation. This duo of marquise and oval cut diamonds, set on a wide yellow gold band, plays subtly with contrasts of colour and shape. A powerful piece, conceived as a signature.

bague-4.title: OREA
bague-4.description: Pared back and captivating, this ring brings a radiant cut diamond into the light on a fine gold setting. An elegant choice for those who love clean lines and elongated stones.

bague-3.title: DELIA
bague-3.description: A classic and timeless piece. This ring showcases a cushion cut centre diamond, heightened by a halo of meticulously set diamonds. The polished gold band completes the whole with discreet elegance. An ideal piece to celebrate a promise, to mark a precious moment, or simply to light up everyday life with a rare brilliance.

bague-2.title: LYNA
bague-2.description: Contemporary design and bold volumes: this double ring combines modernity with refinement. Two diamond-paved bands come together around a pear-shaped diamond, creating a play of contrast between structure and lightness. A ring that asserts its style while remaining faithful to a precious elegance.

bague-1.title: CYRA
bague-1.description: A timeless duo. The pear cut solitaire sits elegantly on a white gold setting, accompanied by a pavé band for continuous brilliance. A classic style, revisited with refinement.

bague.title: IRIA
bague.description: A perfect balance between brilliance and elegance. This solitaire showcases an oval cut diamond, magnified by a trio of yellow gold bands, one of which is paved with diamonds. A harmonious composition, adaptable to your wishes.

iris.title: IRIS
iris.description: Iris ring – Horizontal pear diamond & 18K gold. A striking design, where the eye loses itself in the brilliance of a fascinating stone. This ring stages a 2 carat pear cut diamond, set horizontally for an avant-garde, hypnotic silhouette. Its open bezel setting, finely worked in 18 carat gold, frames the stone delicately while leaving its back visible, offering striking transparency and light. With its singular presence, evoking a protective eye or a modern talisman, this creation combines mystery with elegance. Its pared-back, architectural design plays on solids and voids, heightening the purity of the diamond and creating a ring that seems to float on the skin. Made entirely in France, this piece embodies a contemporary vision of luxury, where light and gold meet to create a spellbinding aura.

selena.title: SELENA
selena.description: Selena ring – Marquise diamond & pavé in 18K gold. A ring worthy of a queen, where brilliance and elegance unite in perfect harmony. Its centre is lit by a 1.75 carat marquise cut diamond, a stone of exquisite proportions whose elongated curves catch the light with fascinating intensity. Embracing the stone with grace, an 18 carat gold setting paved with diamonds traces a silhouette inspired by royal crowns. Every detail of this piece is designed to create a sumptuous play of light, heightening the brilliance of the centre diamond and evoking an almost celestial glow. Made entirely in France, this ring embodies jewellery craftsmanship in all its splendour, an exceptional piece made for those who reign with boldness and refinement.

sofia.title: SOFIA
sofia.description: Sofia ring – Asscher diamond, pavé & 18K gold. A perfect balance between modernity and timelessness. This ring elevates a 2 carat Asscher cut diamond, whose infinite facets capture light with spellbinding depth. Set in an 18 carat gold bezel, the stone seems to merge with the setting, sitting delicately on the finger for an absolutely fluid wear. A meticulous pavé of diamonds underlines the brilliance of the piece, creating a subtle play of reflections between gold and light. Its low, structured design, at once architectural and refined, gives this ring an assured elegance, made to travel through time with grace. Designed and made in France with exceptional craftsmanship, this piece embodies a contemporary vision of luxury, between power and delicacy.

daphne.title: DAPHNE
daphne.description: Évanescence ring – Pear diamond & 18K gold. An airy creation where light and gold meet in perfect balance. This boldly designed ring opens delicately at its centre, letting a 2 carat pear cut diamond float like a drop of light suspended on the skin. Its pure, fascinating brilliance seems to defy gravity, catching every reflection with rare intensity. The 18 carat gold setting, minimalist and pared back, creates a play of solids and voids that heightens the levitating effect of the diamond. An architectural feat that elevates the very essence of jewellery: purity and grace. Made entirely in France, this ring embodies innovation and jewellery craftsmanship, offering a contemporary interpretation of timeless luxury.

kyra.title: KYRA
kyra.description: Kyra oval ring – 2ct diamond & pavé in 18K gold. A true work of the jeweller's art, where curve and light interlace with infinite grace. This sculptural ring brings forward a 2 carat oval cut diamond, radiant with purity and refinement. Its brilliance is heightened by a magnificent pavé of diamonds, dressing the setting in a luminous halo that accentuates every movement. Made in 18 carat gold, this creation of pure curves embodies a perfect balance between architecture and poetry. Every line has been designed for a wear that is both fluid and airy, underlining the timeless beauty of its design. Made in France with exceptional craftsmanship, this ring is an ode to contemporary elegance, an exceptional piece destined to cross generations.

mia.title: MIA
mia.description: Toi & Moi ring – Pear diamonds & pavé in 18K gold. Elegance and refinement unite in this Toi & Moi ring, an exceptional piece of jewellery that celebrates love and duality with brilliance. Its emblematic design stages two superb pear cut diamonds of 1 carat each, delicately facing one another to symbolise the perfect union. The 18 carat gold setting, subtly curved, is heightened by a fine pavé of diamonds that accentuates the brilliance of the principal stones and brings an additional touch of light. Every detail has been designed to magnify this unique piece, made entirely in France in the respect of jewellery traditions. A precious and timeless ring, made to celebrate the most beautiful love stories.
